title: TuringAdvice: A Generative and Dynamic Evaluation of Language Use

bias_targets.methodology: Human evaluation (via Mechanical Turk) categorizing generated advice as 'Dangerous', supplemented by qualitative analysis of the generated text to identify misogynistic, sexist, and 'red pill' language (e.g., misgendering, using derogatory alt-right terms, or endorsing misogynistic figures).
Human evaluation categorizing generated advice as 'Dangerous' upon finding explicitly racist language in the models' open-ended responses to given situations.
